visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a young Asian woman in a black and white patterned kimono standing by a railing at night in Kusatsu Onsen. Dense white steam rises from the Yubatake thermal fields behind her, illuminated by warm yellow and purple lights. She smiles warmly at the camera. The scene then cuts to her sitting on a wooden bench, submerging her feet into the steaming public foot bath, looking relaxed and happy as the mist swirls around her. (2) A visual montage captures various family moments: a young girl in a pink kimono dances on a blue sofa in a well-lit living room, and later, the woman and child explore a museum-like space with large, ornate gold-framed pictures on textured stone walls. We then see the view from a moving car arriving at Narita Airport, followed by an older man in a dark quilted jacket walking hand-in-hand with the young girl through a bright airport corridor. (3) A sleek black Toyota van is shown driving through a street adorned with vibrant pink cherry blossoms. A driver in a black vest and white shirt is seen loading heavy suitcases into the van's trunk. The camera pans the vehicle's interior, showing immaculate white seats with lace protectors and a child seat where the toddler is seen sleeping soundly under a beige blanket while the van is in motion. (4) Daytime footage shows the expansive Yubatake in Kusatsu with hot water flowing over wooden channels, creating a thick, ethereal mist. The woman is seen interacting with the town, showing the exterior of the modern Japanese inn 'Yubatake Souisui.' Interior shots reveal a luxury hotel room with twin beds and a private outdoor stone bath on a balcony where steam constantly rises, indicating the high temperature of the spring. (5) The video continues with a sequence of local attractions: a vendor preparing dango over steam, people enjoying a public foot bath near a rocky waterfall, and a traditional performance involving water splashing. It transitions to city views of the Tokyo skyline at night and the family visiting a Harry Potter-themed attraction where the child holds a wand. The final scenes show the family celebrating a birthday with a cake and the woman taking a mirror selfie in a gift shop wearing a Harry Potter scarf.
